sent.zh: 这一切都与光合作用有关，在这一过程中，植物将阳光、二氧化碳和水转变为食物。

en: the gas produced when animals breathe out, when carbon is burned in air, or when animal or vegetable substances decay

sent.en: Their sons are noisy and mischievous.
sent.zh: 他们的几个儿子又吵又淘气。

rem: mis (错误) + chiev (看作chief, 首领) + ous → 假冒首领的恶作剧 → 恶作剧
en: someone who is mischievous likes to have fun, especially by playing tricks on people or doing things to annoy or embarrass them

syn.tran: 淘气的；（人、行为等）恶作剧的；有害的

pos.z: 使人哑然失声； 使发愣

sent.en: This suggestion dumbfounded Joe.
sent.zh: 这个建议使乔伊惊呆了。

rem: dumb (哑的) + found (发现) → 发现一件惊天秘密， 不禁哑然失声 → 使人哑然失声

sent.en: an aural stimulus
sent.zh: 听觉刺激

rem: aur (耳； 听) + al (的) → 听觉的
en: relating to the sense of hearing, or someone’s ability to understand sounds

syn.tran: [生物]听觉的；耳的；气味的；先兆的

words.z: 光环；气氛；（中风等的）预兆；气味

sent.en: A man in camp took a barometer reading at half-hour intervals.
sent.zh: 营地里的一个人每半小时看一次气压计。

rem: baro (重压) + meter (仪表) → 气压计
en: an instrument that measures changes in the air pressure and the weather, or that calculates height above sea level

syn.tran: [气象]气压计；睛雨表；显示变化的事物

words.z: [气象] 自动记录式气压计

sent.en: We signed a triennial contract yesterday.
sent.zh: 昨日签了一项三年的合约。

sent.en: The triennial Council on Legislation affects all club and district activities. The following information outlines district and club responsibilities in the years before and during the Council.
sent.zh: 每三年一次的立法会议对所有扶轮社及地区活动都会造成影响。以下的资料，指示地区及扶轮社在立法会议的前几年及立法会议期间的责任。

rem: tri (三) + enn (年) + ial → 每三年一度的
en: happening every three years

sent.en: Jerry realized that he had no sensation in his legs.
sent.zh: 杰里意识到自己双腿都没有了知觉。

rem: 来自sens (e) (感觉) + ation → 感情
en: a feeling that you get from one of your five senses, especially the sense of touch

words.z: 明智的；明显的；意识到的；通晓事理的
轰动的；耸人听闻的；非常好的；使人感动的
感觉的；知觉的；传递感觉的
愚蠢的；无知觉的；无意识的
毫无知觉地；无意识地；不省人事地
感觉，官能；观念；道理；理智
可感觉到的东西；敏感的人

syn.tran: [光][天]亮度；聪明，活泼；鲜艳；愉快

words.z: 明亮的，鲜明的；聪明的；愉快的
明亮；变亮；活跃；快乐高兴

sent.en: In his speech, he referred to a recent trip to Canada.
sent.zh: 在他的讲话中，他提到了最近的加拿大之行。

fun.text: re（回）+ fer（带）—— 把话题带回去，所以是「提及、参考」

rem: re + fer (带来， 拿来) → 提交， 谈及
en: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them

syn.tran: 涉及；委托；归诸于；使…求助于

words.z: 可归因于…；可参考的；可交付的；可涉及的
参考，参照；涉及，提及；参考书目；介绍信；证明书
引用（reference的过去分词）；附…以供参考

pos.z: 星的； 星形的； 主要的； 主角的

sent.en: the company’s stellar growth
sent.zh: 这家公司辉煌的发展

rem: stell (星星) + ar → 星的； 星形的
en: relating to the stars

sent.en: Flames poured out of the windows of the building.
sent.zh: 火焰从大楼窗口冒出来。

sent.en: They rushed past us with buckets of water and tried to douse the flames .
sent.zh: 他们提着一桶桶水跑过我们身边去灭火。

en: hot bright burning gas that you see when something is on fire

words.z: 艳丽的；火焰似的；炫耀的

sent.en: The furniture had been left by the previous occupants.
sent.zh: 家具是先前的住户留下的。

rem: 来自occupy (v. 占据)
en: someone who lives in a house, room etc

words.z: 已占用的；使用中的；无空闲的

sent.en: Jobs developed an appreciation for typography, the style and arrangement of printed characters.
sent.zh: 乔布斯渐渐喜欢上排印术——打印字符的版面设计与安排。

sent.en: But the term is a catchall for multiple techniques to handle elements like typography, graphics and video.
sent.zh: 但是这个术语涵义很广，也指处理排印、图像和视频等元素的多种技术。

rem: typo (印刷工) + graph (写； 图) + y → 排版， 排印
en: the work of preparing written material for printing

words.z: 排印错误；排字工；印刷工

pos.z: 公认的真理， 自明之理

sent.en: His speech was just a collection of clichés and truisms.
sent.zh: 他的演说就是一堆陈词滥调和自明之理。

rem: tru ( = truth， 真理) + ism → 真理
en: a statement that is clearly true, so that there is no need to say it

syn.tran: 自明之理；老生常谈；老套；众所周知；真实性

pos.z: 禁止的， 抑制的； 价格极高的

sent.en: The cost of land in Tokyo is prohibitive.
sent.zh: 东京地价令人望而却步。

rem: 来自prohibit (禁止) + ive → 抑制的

syn.tran: 禁止的，禁止性的；抑制的；（费用，价格等）过高的；类同禁止的

words.z: 禁止；禁令；禁酒；诉讼中止令

sent.en: Jo has a flair for languages.
sent.zh: 乔有语言天赋。

rem: 不要羡慕别人的天赋 (flair) ， 上帝对每个人都是公平的 (fair) → 天赋
en: a natural ability to do something very well

pos.z: 谦虚的， 谦让的， 谦逊的； 适度的

sent.en: You’re too modest! You’ve been a huge help to us.
sent.zh: 你太谦虚了！你帮了我们大忙呢。

rem: mod (风度) + est → 做事讲究风度 → 谦让的
en: someone who is modest does not want to talk about their abilities or achievements

syn.tran: 谦虚的，谦逊的；适度的；端庄的；羞怯的

sent.en: The region’s heavy industry is still inefficient and moribund.
sent.zh: 该地区的重工业依然效率低下，没有活力。

sent.en: A cut in interest rates will help the country’s moribund housing market.
sent.zh: 利率的下调对于该国疲软的住房市场将起到促进作用。

rem: mori (看作mort ， 死) + bund (即将) → 即将死的 → 垂死的
en: a moribund organization, industry, etc is no longer active or effective and may be coming to an end

sent.en: the unaccountable shyness she always felt in Louise’s presence
sent.zh: 她在路易丝面前总是感到的莫名羞涩

sent.en: For some unaccountable reason, he arrived a day early.
sent.zh: 不知何故，他早到了一天。

rem: un (无) + accountable (a. 可解释的) → 无法解释的
en: very surprising and difficult to explain

syn.tran: 无责任的；莫名其妙的；不可理解的

sent.en: Behind the gray walls there are human sparks, and yet never a conflagration.
sent.zh: 灰色的大墙后面仍有人性的火花，只是永远也不会燃成大火了。

sent.en: But institute Pan teachs world of sad in conflagration decline, the handwritten note that Pan Jiao gives disappears in conflagration.
sent.zh: 但研究所潘教授在大火中不幸辞世，潘教授的手写笔记在大火中消失。

rem: con + flagr (烧) + ation → 大火
en: a very large fire that destroys a lot of buildings, forests etc

syn.tran: 大火；快速燃烧；突发；冲突

sent.en: He looked up at me through a miasma of cigarette smoke.
sent.zh: 他在香烟烟雾中抬头看着我。

sent.en: A foul miasma lay over the town.
sent.zh: 一阵难闻的瘴气笼罩在小镇的上空。

en: dirty air or a thick unpleasant mist that smells bad
